sloka: यवीयान् मम स भ्राता जटायुः नाम वानराः ।यम् आख्यात हतम् युद्धे रावणेन बलीयसा ॥४-५८-२॥
transliteration: yavīyān mama sa bhrātā jaṭāyuḥ nāma vānarāḥ ।yam ākhyāta hatam yuddhe rāvaṇena balīyasā ॥4-58-2॥

translations.english: 'O monkeys, the one you said to have been killed by mighty Ravana in a combat was my younger brother, Jatayu.
